notes: Access: Tier 1 direct HTTP (curl, desktop UA) was sufficient - site is Next.js with server-rendered RSC-stream JSON embedded in the HTML (self.__next_f.push blocks) carrying product counts, category titles, breadcrumbs and product-grid contents in plain text, no client rendering needed. robots.txt checked first: no Claude-specific disallow (ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot all absent); robots.txt disallows /search, /cart, /checkout, /account, /login - internal search was therefore not used, and discovery relied on nav + sitemap + llms.txt instead (a stronger method than search per the shared core's own guidance). Discovery performed: (1) full main-nav/mega-menu dump (~180 nav 'title' entries scraped from the homepage's embedded nav JSON) - zero Christmas/Halloween/Diwali/Easter/Valentine/Thanksgiving/New Year/Mother's Day/Father's Day/holiday/seasonal terms anywhere in the entire menu, which is organized purely by product type (Chandeliers, Ceiling Lights, Sconces, Pendants, Outdoor Lighting, Rugs, Furniture, Mirrors, Wall Decor, Decorative Accessories, etc.) and by style (Farmhouse, Rustic, Traditional, Transitional, Midcentury Modern); (2) same nav dump repeated on /pages/shop-by-trend, same result; (3) llms.txt (site-provided LLM content index) 'Core Collections & Categories' list - no seasonal/holiday entry; (4) full category sitemap (sitemap-categories-1.xml + -2.xml, 1225 URLs combined) keyword-scanned for christmas/xmas/holiday/halloween/diwali/deepavali/easter/valentine/thanksgiving/new-year/newyear/festiv/mother/father/patrick/wreath/ornament/stocking/mistletoe/tree-top/nutcracker/advent/garland/nativity/season/gift/entertain - only 3 hits in the entire category taxonomy: /categories/holiday-dining-room, /categories/modern-farmhouse-holiday, /categories/home-gift-guide-lighting-home-decor-gift-ideas; (5) sitemap-static.xml checked, no seasonal pages. Each of the 3 hits was fetched and inspected directly (embedded initialProductResult.total + product-name sample, not estimated): 'Home Gift Guide' (home-gift-guide-lighting-home-decor-gift-ideas) returns total:0 products and a blank/default SEO title - excluded both as a Gift Guide (explicit exclusion, rules SS4/SS17) and for 0 products (standard convention). 'Holiday Dining Room' (total:25) and 'Modern Farmhouse Holiday' (total:3) are both genuine PLPs (own URL, exposed product-grid total, real product listing) whose own SEO copy explicitly ties them to 'the holidays' ('Get your dining room ready for the holidays...'), but neither is tied to one specific named occasion (no Christmas/Thanksgiving/New Year branding) and their actual product samples are almost entirely ordinary non-holiday-specific furniture/lighting/decor (chandeliers, sconces, mirrors, dining tables, sideboards, rugs, bar carts - only one item in the 25, a 'Colonial Metalcrafts Window Candle', is genuinely Christmas-themed by name). This matches the recurring cross-project pattern (see qa_notes.md item 2: generic seasonal/style word + mostly non-holiday-specific product mix) that prior workers have consistently self-flagged MANUAL REVIEW rather than silently including or excluding - both kept here as flagged rows for the same reason, not silently dropped. Explicitly checked and confirmed absent (per the task's specific Mother's/Father's Day reminder, evaluated under the same genuine-PLP test as every other holiday, not excluded as a 'generic gift occasion'): Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's Day, Easter, Halloween, Thanksgiving, New Year, Diwali and other Indian festivals, Eid - none appear anywhere in nav, mega menu, shop-by-trend, llms.txt, or the full category sitemap keyword scan. No dedicated Christmas Lighting / Christmas Decorations / Holiday Shop taxonomy exists despite this being a lighting-focused retailer - the closest candidates (the two flagged rows above) are generic dining/farmhouse style pages using 'Holiday' as seasonal-entertaining framing, not a lighting-specific holiday category. No PDPs were crawled; classification used only the PLP-level embedded JSON (title, seoTitle/seoDescription, total count, product-name sample). ADJUDICATION (2026-09-04): removed both rows ('Holiday Dining Room' and 'Modern Farmhouse Holiday') -- sampled product content for each is almost entirely ordinary non-holiday-specific furniture/lighting/decor (chandeliers, sconces, mirrors, dining tables, sideboards, rugs, bar carts, a vanity light) with only 1 of 25 and 0 of 3 items respectively showing any holiday-specific character; these are generic style/room merchandising pages reusing the word 'Holiday' as seasonal-entertaining branding, not genuine holiday-specific product categories per rules SS2/SS5-SS6.
